On the road to Survivor Series: WarGames in Houston, the WWE makes a pit stop in New Orleans for an epic night of massive title bouts and dizzying ladder matches during Money in the Bank.

The premium live event features five high-profile matches, including Roman Reigns defending his World Heavyweight Championship title belt against LA Knight and two ladder matches for championship contracts, as well as celebrity sightings in New Orleans.

Watch on DirectV

When and Where Is WWE Money in the Bank 2026?

Money in the Bank happens on Saturday (Oct. 10), beginning at 6 p.m. ET/3 p.m. PT. The event takes place at Smoothie King Center in New Orleans, Louisiana.

Who’s Performing During WWE Money in the Bank 2026?

Although WWE has yet to announce who would perform “The Star-Spangled Banner” and “God Bless America” at the start of the event, promoters named “A Milli” by Lil Wayne the official song of Money in the Bank . It’s likely the rapper would make an appearance at the WWE event or perform the track since he is from New Orleans.

What’s the Match Card for WWE Money in the Bank 2026?

There are five matches for Money in the Bank. The main event for night one is men’s and women’s ladder matches. The winners of each bout gets a contract for a guaranteed match for their respective championships.

Match Card:

- Men’s Money in the Bank (Ladder Match): Bron Breakker vs. Je’Von Evans vs. Trick Williams vs. Penta vs. CM Punk vs. Kevin Owens

- Women’s Money in the Bank (Ladder Match): Sol Ruca vs. Lola Vice vs. Jacy Jayne vs. Roxanne Perez vs. Lash Legend vs. Tiffany Stratton

- WWE World Heavyweight Championship: Roman Reigns (champion) vs. LA Knight

- Oba Femi vs. Bronson Reed

- WWE Women’s World Championship: Stephanie Vaquer (champion) vs. Becky Lynch vs. Liv Morgan
